ac3.answer: yes, by key. openssl checks every certificate's validity at the verification time, not the issuer's at the leaf's issuance: today both the 2017 CA 029 certificate (from TrustedTpm.cab) and the 2023 re-issue (AIA) verify these EKs, rc 0. At 2017-10-08 only the 2017 one does; the 2023 one fails 'error 9 at 1 depth lookup: certificate is not yet valid'. Both have one SPKI, subject and SKID, so intake pins the CA's key (PINS ca-spki), not either certificate.
